# `intercompany-settings` commands

## `intercompany-settings show`

Show local linked-entry, template and bulk switches. Every switch starts off; no counterpart is consulted.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | company |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-settings.show` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow intercompany-settings show  --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "intercompany-settings show", "input": {}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| — | — | — | — | — | — | This command has no input fields. |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-settings.show`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `linked_entries_enabled` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `templates_enabled` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `bulk_enabled` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "bulk_enabled": false,
  "linked_entries_enabled": false,
  "templates_enabled": false,
  "version": 1
}
```

## `intercompany-settings update`

Replace local feature switches with the expected version and a reason. This creates no accounts, relationship, or ledger entry.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | admin |
| Capability | company |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-settings.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow intercompany-settings update --expected-version 0 --linked-entries-enabled true --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Prepare local intercompany work" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "intercompany-settings update", "input": {"expected_version": 0, "linked_entries_enabled": true}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer | yes | no | — | Version from settings show; zero before first setup.; minimum 0 |
| `linked_entries_enabled` | `--linked-entries-enabled` | boolean | yes | no | — | Enable local relationship setup and drafts; this increment cannot post. |
| `templates_enabled` | `--templates-enabled` | boolean | no | no | false | Reserve the optional template layer; commands arrive in a later increment. |
| `bulk_enabled` | `--bulk-enabled` | boolean | no | no | false | Reserve the optional bulk layer; commands arrive in a later increment. |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-settings.update`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

### Output

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `linked_entries_enabled` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `templates_enabled` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `bulk_enabled` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json

  "bulk_enabled": false,
  "linked_entries_enabled": false,
  "templates_enabled": false,
  "version": 1
}
```
